plan.name: Keep quick factory steps moving
plan.summary: Make -parallel, defaulting to three and including one, bound only steps that need a coding agent: drafting statements or plans and building modeled projects or plumbing plans, including their reviews, fallbacks and repairs; commands, ratifications, merges, closure handling and labels proceed while those slots are full. With positive Parallel, Poll dispatches every idle issue without waiting for an agent slot and returns so Watch keeps polling and publishing its heartbeat, with one step per issue across polls, Wait draining both queued and running steps, and the zero-valued Factory retaining its synchronous Poll compatibility. Acquire a shared cancellable slot only when new agent work is needed, before recording or publishing its run, retain it through that operation's reviews and repairs, recheck issue closure and lease tenure after waiting, and release it on success, error, panic or cancellation while preserving protocol checks, recovery checks and reuse of recorded results. Update the existing scheduling tests, the command's flag help, SPEC.md and docs/factory.md to describe agent slots and continuing heartbeats, citing the existing decisions and this ratified plan in changed SPEC bullets. This refines D-0113 under D-0105, D-0069, D-0073, D-0074, D-0237, D-0122 and D-0294; the merger must record the new scheduling decision because the plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestQuickStepsRunWithAllAgentSlotsFull455
tests.says: Within one poll, a gate-passing approved plumbing pull request merges, another issue's ratification is recorded and answered, and an ordinary command is answered while three builds remain running and another agent step waits.

tests.name: TestWaitingAgentStepsRemainSingleAndRespectCapacity455
tests.says: Drafts, plumbing plans, plans of issues, modeled builds and plumbing builds read their issues while slots are full, start no agent or run record before capacity is free, remain single across polls, and start once a slot is released, at both one and three slots.

tests.name: TestWatchHeartbeatsAndCancelsWithFullAgentSlots455
tests.says: With all agent slots occupied and another issue queued, Watch continues polling and publishing Activity heartbeats, then cancellation drains every step without starting or recording the queued agent.

tests.name: TestClosedQueuedIssueDoesNotStartAnAgent455
tests.says: An issue read while all agent slots are full is checked again after waiting, so closing it prevents its agent run and run record without blocking the poll.

usage.summary: Created `plan.json` and four acceptance tests covering agent slots, quick steps, per-issue exclusion, heartbeats, and cancellation. The first check passed: all four tests fail on the baseline, and `repo/` remains unchanged.
